lanes.title: Shared values and ABI integration owner
HTTP profile and owning handler/module join
MCP provenance decision and ordinary profile
Independent forms source assessment and optional producer
Fixtures, resource harness and acceptance ledger

tasks.title: Freeze caller contracts and workload registry
acceptance: Owners review each admitted domain, error/order/identity obligation and consumer; public arbitrary-unknown and hand-built schemas remain fully legacy TS.
contracts.md and caller-inventory.json distinguish deployed MCP, HTTP 501, forms and handle mode; no full-port claim.

tasks.title: Assess bounded HTTP adoption join
acceptance: C01 source-owner contract names exact existing-handler join and owning files, or states absence without inventing a new HTTP feature.
Package/workerd fixture proof and default deployed adoption are separately testable gates; blocked join retains default 501.

tasks.title: Freeze state sequencing and bridge contract
acceptance: Contract preserves readRevision → hash(raw) → readReceipt → replay OR age → membership/by → normalize/ref-extract → ordered loads and read auth-first.
Protected graph never crosses arbitrary OperationInvoker callbacks; unproven/generated-handler/internal calls retain legacy TS.

tasks.title: Agree owner-plan and shared-file handoffs
acceptance: No second currency, Decimal, wire authority, catalog or compiler work; immutable data copies and private owner tokens establish provenance, never freeze/shape alone.
Each lane has exclusive module files and exact-values publishes A03.foundation before arithmetic completion.

tasks.title: Inspect installed MCP SDK producer seam early
acceptance: Decision includes source/version and evidence that a protected graph can stay inaccessible until conversion; types, freeze or SDK object inspection do not certify it.
Deferred MCP is explicitly unported and does not block HTTP preparation or deployment package proof.

tasks.title: Assess forms producer separately
acceptance: No JSON lineage is inferred for form objects; coercion, duplicate and current __proto__ semantics are explicit.
Decision permits independent HTTP JSON progress and states that deferred forms are not ported.

tasks.title: Prepare immutable owner plans in TS
acceptance: Descriptor/default/bounds mutation, forged schema tags and freeze-without-provenance do not mutate registered plans or promote legacy schemas.
Owner-plan TS fixtures preserve current descriptor normalization/default validation semantics and synchronous behavior.

tasks.title: Prepare values AST codec and whole-call comparator
acceptance: Current/prepared TS agree over values matrix and legacy traces; getters are never eagerly snapshotted or shadow-executed.
Prepared TS is independently adoptable; hand-built schemas and unknown encode/decode inputs retain full legacy scope.

tasks.title: Prepare interfaces HTTP framing/binding plan
acceptance: First unknown JS-enumeration key, first missing shape field, first bound derived-input error remain in order; explicit own null/undefined differs from values.
HTTP currency-string/string-boolean deferral rules remain distinct; no defaults or manufactured values schema.

tasks.title: Prepare generated-state owner plan
acceptance: Generated scalars stay presence-only, strict positive ≤15-digit versions and extra-ref permissiveness persist; operation defaults stay host-owned.
Generated fills are fresh arrays/shallow copy, interim input identity unchanged; permissive unknown loader results never enter owned cache.

tasks.title: Prepare ordinary MCP plan independently of adoption
acceptance: Exact ref keys/ID ≤256 UTF-16 units and arbitrary digits versions remain MCP-specific; query operation_id remains unknown business member.
InvalidParams projection and sealed host path preserved; pure profile work proceeds even when SDK adoption is deferred.

tasks.title: Wire private prepared hooks without public API drift
acceptance: A1/B2 current/facade legacy traces match; unknown/default/schema accessors observe the old evaluation order.
Private prepared calls reach extracted modules while unknown callers remain TS; no semantic exception retry.

tasks.title: Define validation ABI extension and decision vectors
acceptance: Vectors distinguish -0, huge rounded JSON integers, 1e400, numeric strings, null/bool/array/object, lone surrogate keys/text and own __proto__.
Host JSON semantics preserved; number-free opaque json is never used as transport, fixed-width counts reject before coercion.

tasks.title: Build ordered input transport arena
acceptance: Host parser numeric outcomes including nonfinite and -0 remain representable and reach appropriate profile/hash rejection stage.
Numeric-looking key order, duplicate JSON keys, own __proto__, controls and lone surrogates retain exact data.

tasks.title: Create private parser token and controlled lineage
acceptance: Forged tokens, frozen proxies, schema tags and mutated/exposed public copies cannot enter owned execution; no adopt(unknown).
Malformed/empty/scalar-root JSON, byte caps/chunk cancellation, BOM and syntax errors match current host stage; forms retain their path.

tasks.title: Implement owner registration and generation handles
acceptance: Accessor/proxy schemas remain legacy; pre/post-registration mutation, schema identity reuse, forged defaults and duplicate/invalid descriptors cannot corrupt plans.
Foreign/stale/disposed handles fail construction before execution, release is idempotent and no caller-controlled unbounded type-string cache.

tasks.title: Publish complete current and prepared-TS comparator ledger
acceptance: Current/prepared baselines are separate auditable measured outcomes, not inferred from extraction or removed string parsing.
A1–A3/B2 traces and default/empty/sentinel identity agree; prepared TS remains independently adoptable.

tasks.title: Implement ordered values traversal and policy
acceptance: B1 native fixed/seeded fixtures match all ordered errors, paths and values; failure never publishes partial result.
No JSON Schema/Serde default policy; create/update/nullability/nullable-array precedence and legacy presence remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement owned codec dispatch and materialization
acceptance: Exact spelling/leading zeros/-0/scale/canonical text, numeric JSON refusal, money currency/keys and temporal edges match shared oracle.
Repeated defaults/empty arrays keep identity and frozen structure; returned structural BigInt/Decimal/Money match TS, generated-state arrays stay fresh.

tasks.title: Implement HTTP-only native profile
acceptance: No values interpreter or URL/Intl predicate prerequisite; HTTP first unknown → first missing → first bound order and path spelling match.
HTTP ref extras/currency-string and deferred string/boolean semantics remain permissive as baseline; top-level/action_handle rules unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement generated-state native profile
acceptance: Native vectors preserve safe-number conversion, extra ref-member permissiveness, unescaped legacy paths and state-specific error accumulation.
No external store/auth/ref loads are performed by pure profile; model/defaulted scenario callable remains host-owned.

tasks.title: Implement ordinary MCP native policy
acceptance: Native pure fixtures agree with current/prepared including multi-error disagreement cases; sealed mode untouched.
Implementation of profile alone never certifies SDK producer seam or claims deployed migration.

tasks.title: Land coordinated minimal binding and shared module registrations
acceptance: Actual binding, not serializer-only simulation, preserves bits/UTF-16/keys and checks malformed version/length/fixed-width overflow before coercion.
C04 smoke inventory and bootstrap checks prove real bytes; fake bindings and native-only JSON cannot complete V03.

tasks.title: Register HTTP action after exact binding handoff
acceptance: Actual HTTP whole-profile binding compiles and runs without waiting for values/predicates/SDK/forms; no duplicate numeric transport or shared-file race.

tasks.title: Register generated-state action in serial integration queue
acceptance: State actual binding compiles against presence/ref policy without full values traversal; integrator alone edits shared roots.

tasks.title: Register ordinary MCP action in serial integration queue
acceptance: Pure MCP actual binding compiles and owns separate profile policy; no implication of verified SDK lineage.

tasks.title: Register values interpreter and materialization in serial queue
acceptance: Actual whole values calls reconstruct structural/default/sentinel results and ordered failures; shared module edits remain serialized.

tasks.title: Prove demand-ordered host predicate protocol
acceptance: No lossy String conversion or eager precomputation before earlier violations; runtime URL/locale/timezone/currency behavior matches.
Unsupported plan fallback precedes input evaluation, never retries semantic exceptions; HTTP can progress without these callbacks.

tasks.title: Encode retained interpreter results inside request
acceptance: Same-call normalize+encode parity preserves scale/canonical text, shape/error paths and structural/default identity.
Request-scoped result cannot be forged, reused after disposal or adopted from arbitrary unknown.

tasks.title: Wire proved predicate and retained-encode glue
acceptance: Host invocation order, unsupported-plan selection and lossless text/error formatting agree through actual binding; same-session results never escape disposal.

tasks.title: Run actual-binding values parity and identity
acceptance: B1/B2/A1 have zero unexplained differences for supported values profile; no partial output on failure.
Tagged UTF-16/f64 fixtures do not collapse -0/nonfinite/identity and retained legacy traces prove Rust is not invoked.

tasks.title: Run independent HTTP actual-binding profile parity
acceptance: A2/B2 errors and raw business inputs agree including optional-property absence and baseline pointer spelling.
Binding does not allocate/validate before host auth/CSRF/ID stages when installed at consumer.

tasks.title: Run state actual-binding profile parity
acceptance: A3/B2 pure state matches current aggregate paths/errors and ordered refs without store side effects.
Generated defaults/scalars/interim identity remain in owning scope.

tasks.title: Run MCP actual-binding profile parity
acceptance: A2/B2 preserve exact refs, ID UTF-16 limits, InvalidParams and sealed-path selection.
Passing vectors do not mark MCP production port complete when SDK branch is deferred.

tasks.title: Finalize request/plan limits and cleanup implementation
acceptance: Stale/foreign/generation handles reject before Rust; traps/stack overflow are adapter failures, not legacy cycle RangeError.
No active eviction, global result retention or unchecked counts; public legacy domain unchanged.

tasks.title: Apply finalized owner-plan budget and release policy
acceptance: Registration over budget rejects owner before serving; no active plan eviction, stale handle execution or retained defaults after owner disposal.
Same prepared/Rust owner contract applies without caching arbitrary schemas or narrowing legacy exports.

tasks.title: Prove HTTP resource readiness independently
acceptance: Owned prepared TS and Rust enforce same fixed policy; memory plateaus and no result/default survives its owner scope.
HTTP rollout is unblocked by completed HTTP resource evidence, without waiting for optional MCP/forms or values predicates.

tasks.title: Apply owned budgets to prepared values comparator
acceptance: Selected backend does not change owned limits; unsupported legacy plans keep old success/exception domain.
Earlier semantic failures retain precedence over later predicates/allocation work.

tasks.title: Complete cross-profile resource proof
acceptance: B3 measured memory plateaus under representative and adversarial workloads; defined limits have no Rust traps and no stale cross-request reuse.
No defaults survive owner release or results request disposal; state successful replay incurs no new-plan budget before replay.

tasks.title: Implement canonical private provenance bridge handoff
acceptance: HTTP lane consumes bridge API without editing runtime/invoke.ts; state lane alone owns bridge modules.
Public copy mutation loses token use; unknown/custom callbacks retain legacy validation; copy cost is separately observable.

tasks.title: Install whole HTTP action at existing validation point
acceptance: A2/B4 order/status/body, body-cap/malformed JSON, top-level/action_handle, missing/unknown/bounds and HTML redisplay match.
No Rust work before current validation point; one selected backend per request and no semantic-error retry.

tasks.title: Prove actual handler package consumer in workerd
acceptance: B4/A2 real workerd request reaches existing owning handler and canonical state invocation; mock or fixture-only JS binding is insufficient.
Report package consumer proof separately from default deployed traffic; unit injected invoker does not certify deployment.

tasks.title: Decide bounded default deployment adoption
acceptance: Decision cannot create a new HTTP feature or treat fixture-only workerd as real default production use.
Default join acceptance explicitly dispatches V08.4/V08.5; absence leaves package completion possible with deployed adoption blocked.

tasks.title: Land owning assembly join when accepted
acceptance: Owning default route serves existing handler rather than interim 501; no new server/feature scope.
A4/B4 assembly and workerd trace preserves host stages and sealed/other routes.

tasks.title: Verify shared delivery module join when accepted
acceptance: A4/B4 owning joined entry/map serves actual handler using shipped binary, not fixture-only module inventory.
Missing/corrupt/wrong-version binaries fail visibly; release inventory/source maps never decode Wasm as text.

tasks.title: Close HTTP package and deployment ledger separately
acceptance: Package gate is complete only with actual handler/binding/workerd proof.
Default deployment is enabled only on accepted implemented join or explicitly blocked; optional branch boxes remain open when deferred.

tasks.title: Install owned state execution after replay/auth only
acceptance: Matching receipt replays even when input is now expired/forbidden/malformed or current plan/budget fails; conflicting raw reuse fails before normalizing.
Array fills/defaults never change persisted hash; admission/load/stale/archive/conflict-current/fence/read order unchanged.

tasks.title: Prove durable state consumer traces and copy cost
acceptance: Exact mutation trace and read auth-first match baseline; no eager ref loads on earlier failure, toJSON legacy ordering unchanged.
Raw digest/receipt compatibility and replay survive backend change; copies included in economic evidence.

tasks.title: Decide MCP adoption from complete seam and profile proof
acceptance: Only parser-created internal lineage before exposure, without second parse or object adoption, enables branch.
HTTP package/default gate remains independent; deferred result cannot be labelled full MCP port.

tasks.title: Implement SDK-owned ordinary path only when accepted
acceptance: A2/B4 SDK JSON-RPC framing/error/results and InvalidParams agree; sealed mode keeps current orchestration.
Actual consumer proof, not profile fixtures alone, is required before MCP adoption enabled.

tasks.title: Implement faithful form producer only when accepted
acceptance: Forms current/prepared/binding semantics and error/form draft match; no silent __proto__ fix or arbitrary-object adoption.
Unproved producer remains TS and branch incomplete.

tasks.title: Hook accepted form producer through HTTP owner
acceptance: Optional forms acceptance proves complete consumer and faithful protected lineage; HTTP JSON semantics preserved.

tasks.title: Close optional adoption decisions without false completion
acceptance: MCP/forms deferred/legacy status never marks their full port done; required scope-review gate may close while optional work remains open.
HTTP progress/measurement only consumes decision ledger, not deferred implementation.

tasks.title: Assemble profile differential ledger
acceptance: All owned rows agree across current/prepared/native/actual binding; native-only JSON not credited.
Separate HTTP first errors, state aggregates, values accumulations and MCP stages remain visible.

tasks.title: Precommit workloads and numeric adoption budgets
acceptance: Precommitment precedes final comparisons and contains representative malformed/error-heavy HTTP/state/replay workloads plus supported MCP only.
Worker CPU timing follows shared harness policy; leaf/native timings or removed type parsing cannot justify adoption.

tasks.title: Prepare private release selection and rollback join
acceptance: Missing/corrupt/version/ABI/init failures in selected Rust fail startup; ordinary package API remains synchronous/importable.
No receipt/raw-hash/default/schema migration and no duplicate auth/store/provider execution or shadowing legacy getters.

tasks.title: Measure complete selected calls and retained resources
acceptance: Zero unexplained parity differences and complete-call budgets assessed at precommitted thresholds; core-entry counts show real routing.
Results distinguish package fixture, default deployment and deferred consumers; no Rust-only interpreter or parser-removal inference.

tasks.title: Review Rust versus prepared-TS adoption decision
acceptance: No benefit retains prepared TS and experiment evidence; supported selected Rust requires C04, HTTP package/resource/parity and rollback proof.
State normalization stays after replay/auth even if HTTP enabled; deferred production paths never claimed migrated.

tasks.title: Audit changed source, exports and release inventory
acceptance: No unexplained new diagnostic, public handle/export drift or hidden retained TS; complete source/output/lifetime ledger is reviewable.
Rollback/release bytes and raw receipt digest/schema remain unchanged; missing gate reported explicitly.

tasks.title: Reconcile living filetree after actual merges
acceptance: Merged implementation coverage/checkpoint reflects complete reviewed changes; this planning conversion itself does not advance it.
Final source list distinguishes implemented, proposed, unsupported and retained TS with ownership.

tasks.title: Review declared-port completion and gaps
acceptance: Declared owned port is complete only with supported real binding and actual handler workerd proof plus rollback/resources/source review.
Blocked adoption or deferred optional branches stay labelled; never claim complete legacy validator/MCP/forms migration.

tasks.title: Caller and ownership contracts reviewed
acceptance: Five profile/input domains, workloads, baseline and HTTP/source ownership gap agreed.

tasks.title: Prepared TS complete-call baseline reviewed
acceptance: A1–A3/B2 current/prepared semantics, identity, order, timings and retained legacy traces agree.

tasks.title: Versioned ownership ABI proved through actual binding
acceptance: Same-call scalar/UTF-16/provenance/handle vectors pass native, Node/Bun and C04 workerd; references/version/limit decisions recorded.

tasks.title: Values ordered interpreter and identity proved
acceptance: Complete values semantics match shared A04/A05 exact codecs through native and binding; identity/no partial results proved.

tasks.title: Host predicate and optional encode contract proved
acceptance: Demand-ordered host text/predicates/errors and same-session encoding match; unsupported plans selected TS before execution.

tasks.title: Independent policy profiles reviewed
acceptance: HTTP/MCP/state pure profile parity includes intentional version/ref/error/presence disagreements; no invented values schemas.

tasks.title: All owned resource/lifetime gates reviewed
acceptance: B3 same prepared/Rust versioned budget and cleanup plateau evidence reviewed; no legacy narrowing or pre-replay Rust work.

tasks.title: Actual HTTP package consumer and adoption ledger reviewed
acceptance: B4 actual handler/canonical invocation/Wasm/workerd proved; accepted join requires V08.4/V08.5 or default 501 remains explicitly blocked.

tasks.title: Canonical owned-state sequencing and durable proof reviewed
acceptance: A3/A4/B4 raw hash/receipt replay/auth/ref loads/fences/reads and protected copy cost match; unproven paths retained TS.

tasks.title: Optional MCP/forms outcome ledger reviewed
acceptance: Decision review only: accepted MCP/forms require conditional consumer task proofs; deferred optional task boxes stay open and their full ports are not complete.

tasks.title: Measured backend/adoption and rollback decision reviewed
acceptance: B5 actual complete-call evidence and precommitted budgets/native reuse justify selected outcome; unsupported/default deployment scope explicit.

tasks.title: Final declared owned-port completion review
acceptance: Final-source-checks, verify.log, rollout decision and merged filetree review complete; definition of done satisfied or adoption blocked explicitly.
